_draft: DRAFT: everything in quotes below that isn't a fact from CLAUDE.md is draft copy for div to rewrite.
name: Divyalakshmi Prem Sudha
tagline: from a particle to a galaxy.
description: div builds platforms, apps and odd little universes. shipyard, revy, moodmelody.ai, and a lot of folded paper.
origin: it started small. a grade 8 school trip from dubai to cern, and a bubble chamber full of spirals.

fold.title: fold
fold.headline: complex systems are just simple folds in the right order.
fold.body: that's how i think about software. one crease, then the next. get the order right and a flat square turns into a crane.
fold.personal: i started origami at 5. when i leave a place, my teammates get a handmade crane with a note inside.

light.title: light
light.headline: the sky does gradients better than any designer.
light.body: 7+ years of art. pencil, acrylics, palette knife, watercolor, and posters for causes i care about. i still design in figma like i'm holding a brush.
light.personal: these planets will wear my own acrylic paintings.

sound.title: sound
sound.headline: music is just math that learned to feel.
sound.body: 6 years in a professional choir. learning guitar. a soft spot for karaoke, no matter who is listening.
sound.personal: press play when it's here. it never plays on its own.

gravity.title: gravity
gravity.headline: small, steady pulls win the long game.
gravity.body: compound growth is just gravity with patience. money, skills, teams: same curve.
gravity.ambition: build a company with real customers, hire a great team, take it all the way to ipo or acquisition. then do it again.

earth.title: pale blue dot
earth.headline: places i've been.
earth.body: a nod to carl sagan. the foil scratches off country by country, in the order i went.

observatory.title: the observatory
observatory.headline: every project is a constellation. the wins burn gold.
observatory.body: 7 wins across 14 hackathons, and a few things that are still being built.

signal.title: the signal
signal.headline: ask me anything. a signal goes out, an answer comes back.
signal.body: div's bot is still being wired up. until it's live, send a real signal.

beliefs: a confident wrong answer is worse than no answer.
art and tech are better together, especially when someone actually needs it.
good robots shouldn't cost more than dinner.
